query: Which link functions and functional forms should we pre-specify for each outcome type (binary college enrollment, continuous application counts, time-to-event outcomes)?

response.query: Which link functions and functional forms should we pre-specify for each outcome type (binary college enrollment, continuous application counts, time-to-event outcomes)?
response.answer: For binary outcomes like college enrollment, logistic regression is typically used. For continuous outcomes like application counts, linear regression is appropriate. For time-to-event outcomes, Cox proportional hazards model is commonly employed.
